per_spec.spec: a deep-groove rolling element bearing as three distinct solids: an outer ring 52mm outside diameter and 15mm wide with an internal groove, an inner ring 25mm bore with a matching external groove, and eight 7.5mm spheres seated evenly in the groove between them

a piston and connecting rod as two separate solids: a 70mm diameter piston 55mm tall with two 3mm ring grooves and a 20mm gudgeon pin bore across its skirt, and a 140mm long rod with a 20mm small-end bore and a 45mm big-end bore
a crankshaft for a single cylinder: a 30mm diameter main journal 180mm long with a 25mm diameter big-end journal offset 35mm from the axis, joined by two 60x20mm webs, as one fused solid

a two stage reduction as two separate spur gears on parallel axes: a 20 tooth pinion of 3mm module and 18mm face width with a 15mm bore, meshing with a 60 tooth wheel of the same module and face width with a 30mm bore, spaced at their correct centre distance

a worm and worm wheel pair as two solids: a single start worm 24mm outside diameter and 60mm long with a 6mm axial pitch, and a 40 tooth wheel 90mm outside diameter and 15mm wide, mounted on axes at right angles
a rack and pinion as two solids: a 200mm long rack 20mm tall with 24 straight teeth of 4mm module across its top face, and a matching 18 tooth pinion with a 20mm bore positioned in mesh above it

a universal joint as three solids: two identical yokes each with a 30mm shaft 40mm long splitting into two 12mm thick arms 45mm apart bored 10mm, and a cross shaped centre spider with four 10mm trunnions on a common 45mm span

a cam and follower as two solids: an eccentric disc cam 60mm diameter and 12mm thick on a 15mm bore with 8mm of lift, and a flat faced follower 25mm diameter on a 12mm stem 70mm long resting on the cam
a Geneva indexing mechanism as two solids: a driven wheel 100mm diameter and 10mm thick with six radial slots 12mm wide, and a driver plate 60mm diameter carrying a single 11mm pin at a 40mm radius

a lead screw and travelling nut as two solids: a 20mm diameter screw 250mm long with a 4mm pitch square thread, and a rectangular nut 50x50x30mm with a matching internal thread and four 6mm mounting holes

a shaft coupling as three solids: two identical hubs 70mm diameter and 30mm long, each with a 25mm bore, a 8mm keyway and three 9mm bolt holes on a 50mm circle, plus a 70mm diameter 10mm thick elastomer disc between them

a radial impeller and its scroll housing as two solids: a 90mm diameter impeller with twelve backswept vanes 3mm thick on a 15mm hub, and a surrounding volute housing whose passage area grows from 200 to 900 square mm around 360 degrees
